reviews.title: Good tracker. Frustrating interface.
reviews.text: And no, adding more serving sizes doesn’t help, it just makes it more cluttered! Rather than allow you to type the size and abv of a drink you have to select from a list.  If like me you share drinks or pour different sizes at home or even in a craft beer bar this becomes deeply frustrating. A good idea spoiled by poor ux choices.

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.text: This app has helped me make an accurate account of my alcohol intake as, in the past, I tended to equate one drink to one unit. It’s easy to use and a great reminder to stop.

reviews.title: Blocking me because I won’t buy a lifetime
reviews.text: They really slow down the product,  eliminate features and have blocking pop-ups unless you buy a lifetime subscription.  I’m quitting.

reviews.title: Update rubbish
reviews.text: The latest update has upset the graphics for the drinks so it is hard to determine what size drink you have had.  Why change something that wasn’t broken😢
